content.about: Saint Lucia is a mountainous Caribbean island. Its two Pitons rise from the sea. It has a drive-in volcano and hot springs. Two Nobel Prize winners came from it.

standout.text: The Pitons are two volcanic spires rising straight from the sea.

didYouKnow: Saint Lucia has two Nobel laureates.
Sulphur Springs is a drive-in volcano.
Its national day honours Saint Lucy.
